overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures premium dehydrated lemon peel powder for global industrial applications. As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter in India, we produce fine 80 to 100 mesh powder. We process carefully sourced citrus fruits through controlled dehydration to preserve their natural aroma and bright citrus flavor. The resulting ingredient mixes easily into formulations without clumping.

Our manufacturing follows a strict six-step process, from sourcing and sorting to quality inspection and dispatch. We support B2B clients with bulk supply, OEM solutions, and private label services. With export documentation support and custom packaging options, we serve food, beverage, and cosmetic producers worldwide. Every batch offers reliable shelf life and low moisture below seven percent.
highlights: Characteristic bright citrus flavor and aroma
Free-flowing pale yellow to light green appearance
applications: Bakery products like cakes and cookies
Herbal tea blends and beverage infusions
packaging: 25 kg multi-wall paper bags and HDPE containers

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for bulk lemon peel powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity starts at 5 kg for standard bulk supply.

faqs.q: Do you provide OEM and private label packaging?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer OEM and private label services, including custom pouches, jars, and customized outer packaging.

faqs.q: Can we request custom mesh sizes for our manufacturing needs?
faqs.a: Yes, we can accommodate custom mesh sizes and tailor specifications upon request.

faqs.q: Are samples available prior to commercial ordering?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available on request for quality assessment and trial formulations.

faqs.q: What is the shelf life and recommended storage for this product?
faqs.a: It has a shelf life of 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you assist with export documentation for international shipments?
faqs.a: Yes, as an IEC-registered exporter, we provide complete export documentation support for all overseas orders.
